$comment: Copies the duplicate check (scripts/check-duplicates.mjs, #1287) allows today, per pair of files. Each entry has either the ticket that removes it or, when the two blocks only look alike, the reason it stays. Only ever lower a count or delete an entry; a new copy is extracted, never added here.

pairs.reason: Only look alike: both import blocks name the same shared form pieces, which each file uses differently; there is nothing between them to extract.
Only look alike: the props tail and the vocabulary and logger lines that open two different components.
